results.question: Compare the late delivery rate in 2018 with 2017

results.question: Compare the late delivery rate in 2018 with 2017

results.question: How did revenue change in each customer state from 2017 to 2018?
results.sql: SELECT c.customer_state, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017 THEN oi.price + oi.freight_value ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2017, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018 THEN oi.price + oi.freight_value ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2018, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018 THEN oi.price + oi.freight_value ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017 THEN oi.price + oi.freight_value ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_change FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) IN (2017, 2018) GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY revenue_change DESC
